# Fixed-runtime render-bundle file fixtures

Produced by Blender 5.2.3 LTS / e13b728c6880 during the owner's bounded native
feasibility probes, before bundle implementation. They are native-output fixtures,
not files generated by the reader under test. No dependency installation was used.

- literal-float-zip.exr: 4×3 pixels, every RGBA exactly [2,.125,.5,1], FLOAT ZIP.
- passes-float-zip.exr: 32×16 orthographic emission panel. Center beauty is
  [.2,.4,.6,1], depth3, world normal[0,0,1], scalar AOV.375. Explicit FileOutput
  legacy interleaving, FLOAT ZIP. Outside the panel coverage is zero.

Recipes, exact binary/source pins, failures and independent private decode reports:
programme/blender-render-layers-next.md and
workspace tmp/scratch/completion25-blender-bundles/{probe-r2,fileoutput-r3}.
The earlier probe-r1 socket-inventory error is retained separately, not a product
failure. These small fixtures carry no claim about arbitrary image equivalence.

Format reference: https://openexr.com/en/latest/TechnicalIntroduction.html
